content:
tara (Finance): FYI: launching a purchasable "burst credits" marketplace next month. Aim: give self-serve customers a predictable, easy way to buy short-term capacity without changing base rate limits.

mei (Product): Summary: one-time or auto-renew burst credit packs (multiple sizes), optional auto-apply during detected traffic spikes, and explicit invoice lines so customers know what they're charged for.

yusuf (Billing Eng): Implementation notes: new invoice line key = burst_credit_charge. Packs are token-equivalent units. Router will consult org metadata for "burst_auto_apply" and a per-org cap. No changes to core rate-limit enforcement.

alej (Support): How will charges show up? We need copy for billing contacts so they don't get surprised.

tara (Finance): Invoice example snippet we'll use in KB: 
```
line_item_id,description,amount_usd,tag
12345,burst_credit_100k_pack,49.00,burst_credit_charge
```
We'll also add a small preview in the console that shows "if you applied X pack over last 7d, your surcharges would have been $Y".

sam (Legal): Confirmed no change to dispute windows or SLA. We do need a short DPA/TOS note clarifying that burst packs are prepay purchases and non-refundable except for clerical errors. Legal will prepare wording.

oliver (CEO): For sales: can we make enterprise/reserved customers get volume discounts and have purchase-by-invoice option? That will help renewals.

tara (Finance): Yes — enterprise gets negotiated pack pricing and invoice-based billing; self-serve gets card checkout only for now. We'll capture metrics for conversion to invoice purchases.

yusuf (Billing Eng): Rollout plan: feature-flagged backend + console UI. Beta -> 10% -> 100% over 2 weeks. Watchpoints: pack redemption latency, invoice rendering, and dispute volume.

billing-bot: deploy started: burst-marketplace:v1.0.0 -> canary 5% 126-runbook: /runbooks/burst-marketplace

alej (Support): Draft support blurb: "New: buy burst credit packs to absorb short traffic spikes. Packs appear as 'burst_credit_charge' on invoices. Packs are prepay and applied automatically if enabled. See KB for examples."

mei (Product): UX detail: default for existing orgs = burst_auto_apply OFF. New orgs created after launch default ON with a small complimentary 10k trial pack to test.

oliver (CEO): Good. Ensure we have a clear one-pager for sales and a short field FAQ. Also monitor for any unusual churn signal after first billing cycle.

yusuf (Billing Eng): Deploy update: canary healthy on 5% (2026-03-23T22:18:09Z). Logging and metrics hooked to billing-monitoring team.

tara (Finance): Communication plan: KB + blog post + console banner 14/7/1 days pre-launch. Internal pilot invites tomorrow. If you want to test the beta packs, DM me. :party_popper:
